About the Mod

What is Cobblemon?

Cobblemon is a free, open-source Pokémon mod for Minecraft Java Edition. It adds fully animated Pokémon that spawn naturally across every biome — you can catch them, battle with them, breed for better stats, and trade with friends.

Think Pixelmon, but modern. Cobblemon is built natively for Minecraft's engine which means better performance, smoother gameplay and a look that actually fits the world.

On Kingdom Network we've built on top of that foundation with custom competitive systems, land claiming, a ranked PvP ladder, legendary raids, and seasonal events. There's always something to grind for.

Learn About Cobblemon ↗
Get Started

How to Join

Set up and join Kingdom Network in under 5 minutes. Follow these steps and you'll be catching Pokémon in no time.

01
Download a Mod Launcher

You need Minecraft Java Edition and a mod launcher to install Cobblemon. We recommend Modrinth or CurseForge — both are free and beginner-friendly.

↗ Modrinth App ↗ CurseForge App
02
Download Our Modpack

Download the official Kingdom Network Modpack. It contains all required mods, resource packs, and settings needed to join the server. Simply download the pack and import it into your preferred launcher.

📦 Download Modpack
03
Add Our Server

Launch Minecraft through your mod launcher. Go to Multiplayer → Add Server and enter our IP address. Then hit Join Server.

play.mc-kingdom.net
04
Choose Your Starter & Begin

You'll spawn in our hub and be prompted to choose your first Pokémon. Pick your starter, grab your beginner kit, and start exploring. Join our Discord to meet the community and get tips from veteran players.

↗ Join Discord

Frequently Asked Questions

Kingdom Network runs on Minecraft Java Edition. The Cobblemon modpack via Modrinth or CurseForge automatically installs the correct version. You do not need Bedrock Edition.
Over 300 Pokémon are available across multiple generations, including regional variants and special forms. Pokémon spawn naturally in biomes that match their type. The Cobblemon mod is regularly updated adding more Pokémon over time.

Server Rules

By playing on Kingdom Network you agree to follow these rules. Ignorance of a rule is not an excuse — please read them carefully.

01
ConductRespect everyone in the community. Harassment, discrimination, racism, sexism, slurs, hate speech, bullying, or any form of toxic behavior toward players, staff, or the community will not be tolerated.
02
ConductKeep chat clean and readable. Excessive spam, message flooding, repeated text, or constant use of all caps is not allowed.
03
GameplayGriefing, stealing, or intentionally ruining another player's experience is strictly prohibited.
04
ConductNSFW or inappropriate content is not allowed anywhere on the server or Discord. This includes images, videos, links, usernames, or explicit conversations.
05
ConductAdvertising or promoting other servers, communities, social media, or personal projects without permission is forbidden.
06
ConductAll players must follow Minecraft's Terms of Service and Community Guidelines.
07
ConductRespect everyone's privacy. Sharing personal or sensitive information about another person without consent is not allowed.
08
ConductStaff decisions and instructions must be followed. Arguing excessively or refusing to cooperate may result in punishments.
09
ConductPolitical or highly controversial discussions should be avoided to keep the community enjoyable for everyone.
10
GameplayAny form of cheating or unfair advantage is prohibited. This includes hacked clients, X-ray packs, duplication glitches, exploits, macros, or modified gameplay that provides an advantage.
11
EconomyBegging, scamming, or manipulating players for items, money, or rewards is not allowed.
12
ConductToxic behavior of any kind — including provoking arguments, passive-aggressive actions, or intentionally ruining gameplay — is against the rules.
13
ConductImpersonating players, staff members, content creators, or developers is strictly forbidden.
14
EconomyReal-world trading is not permitted. Server items, Cobblemon, currency, or ranks may not be exchanged for real money or outside payments. Official server store purchases are the only exception.
15
GameplayLegendary and Shiny Pokémon belong to the player they spawn on first. That player has priority to catch, battle, or pass the Pokémon to someone else. If they choose to pass, they decide who may attempt it. Delaying excessively or refusing to act may result in the spawn becoming public or despawning. Special event rules may override this system.
16
GameplayExploiting bugs or unintended mechanics is not allowed. Any discovered bugs should be reported to staff immediately. Abuse of exploits may lead to severe punishments, including permanent bans. Helpful reports may be rewarded.
17
GameplayAlternate accounts may not be used to gain unfair advantages, farm rewards, bypass punishments, or generate extra income. Abuse of alts can result in bans on all linked accounts and possible IP bans.
18
TechnicalRedstone builds must be designed responsibly. Always-on clocks, lag machines, excessive automation, chunk-loaded farms, 0-tick systems, or extremely large farms with excessive entities are not allowed. All automated systems should include a manual on/off switch.
19
ConductUse common sense. If an action negatively affects the community, economy, gameplay, or server performance, staff may intervene even if it is not specifically listed above.
